title: Fedora Silverblue Containerization
definition: An immutable operating system that utilizes containerization for development tooling.

difficulty_levels.beginner: A Linux distribution that keeps all development tools in a separate, self-contained space called a container.
difficulty_levels.intermediate: An OS designed to provide an isolated and consistent environment for development, with all tools living within a container.
difficulty_levels.expert: Fedora Silverblue is an immutable Linux distribution that relies on containerization to offer a secure, consistent, and portable development environment.

extra_fields.insight: A Linux distribution utilizing containerization to maintain an isolated and reliable environment for developers.
